items: WASTE BIN WITH 13 GALLON CAPACITY - This 13 gallon trash can is perfect for any household and features a classic rectangular shape in a matte black finish.
CLOROX ODOR PROTECTION - Lidded trash can is formulated with Clorox Odor Protection of the lid to thoroughly block odors for the life of the can.
STEP ON TRASH CAN FOR EASY USE - This kitchen trash can with lid is designed with a foot pedal for hands-free operation. It allows you to throw your trash without having to lift the lid of the can.
KITCHEN TRASH CAN WITH BAG RINGS - Keep the bag slack neatly tucked in while securing the trash bag in place. The interior bag ring liner will prevent the trash bag from falling in.

SUITABLE FOR HOME OR COMMERCIAL USE - Use this dustbin to keep any interior space clean. This 13G/50L garbage bin fits any kitchen and is great for families and office spaces. Rectangle trash can is 18” wide, 14.7” deep, and 25” high.

items.label: Warranty
items.value: We warrant your Glad trash can to be free of defects in material or workmanship for two years. The warranty period begins from the date of purchase as shown on the proof of purchase. The proof of purchase, invoice, or receipt must show the purchase date and the name of the retailer where the product was purchased. In the unlikely event that your product becomes defective, a repair or replacement will be provided at our discretion. The following are not covered by the warranty: Products purchased from an unauthorized retailer, such as, but not limited to, third-party sellers on eBay, Amazon marketplace, etc. Products purchased As-Is, refurbished or used condition. Damage to the product from accidents, misuse, normal wear, or non-home use is excluded.
